correctness.rationale: The exact two-branch Jacobian computation yields density 2u du dr, establishing fresh independent beta retained fractions. The exponential increment covariance matrix is positive definite; difference covariance Ω has determinant d/(2d)^(d−1), and the bounded-range polytope has volume d(log β)^(d−1). The multidimensional Stone theorem applies because increments are nonlattice and a d-fold convolution has an absolutely continuous component. The resulting sharp local probability and mixed local/global conditional volume CLT have their assumptions and boundary cases verified. Finite algebraic and numerical checks were executed and passed, and are distinguished from the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The probability that a randomly queried node cell remains shape regular is a motivated intrinsic statistic for random partitions, tightly linked to regression cell geometry. Its exact dimension-dependent polynomial rarity (including constant) is not a routine finite table calculation or an arbitrary parameter slice, and the conditional standard-normal volume law shows that rare geometric regularity need not change first-order cell-mass fluctuations. Previous relevant work gave only much coarser elongated-cell bounds. The facts address a sharp natural geometric threshold across all fixed dimensions and all fixed beta>1, with explicit scientific limits.
